title: App Crash on Startup
description: The app crashes on startup on iOS 17. This is a critical bug affecting a significant portion of our user base and needs immediate attention. We have received multiple reports.

title: Dark Mode Toggle
description: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page for improved user experience, especially in low-light conditions. This feature has been highly requested by users.

title: Outdated API Docs
description: The API documentation for the /users endpoint is outdated and causing confusion for developers. It needs to be updated to reflect the latest changes.

title: Login button not working
description: The login button is unresponsive on the login page, preventing users from accessing their accounts. This is a high-priority bug.

title: Add social media sharing
description: Allow users to share their results on social media platforms like Twitter and Facebook directly from the app.

title: Incorrect examples in docs
description: The code examples in the documentation are incorrect and lead to errors when followed. They need to be reviewed and corrected.

title: Images not loading
description: Images are not loading in the gallery view, appearing as broken placeholders. This affects the visual appeal and functionality.

title: User Profile Customization
description: Implement options for users to customize their profile pictures and bio information. This will enhance personalization.

title: Search filter not working
description: The search filter on the main page is not returning correct results or sometimes no results at all. This impacts usability.

title: Performance Optimization
description: Investigate and optimize application performance, especially during data loading and complex operations. Users report slowness.

title: Broken links in footer
description: Several links in the website footer are broken, leading to 404 pages. This needs to be fixed to maintain site integrity.

title: Email Notifications
description: Add email notification functionality for important events, such as new messages or updates. This will keep users informed.

title: Missing setup guide
description: A comprehensive setup guide for new developers is missing from the documentation. This hinders onboarding.

title: Incorrect data display
description: Data displayed in the dashboard charts is sometimes incorrect or misaligned with the actual figures. This is a data integrity issue.

title: Export to PDF option
description: Allow users to export reports and data to PDF format for offline viewing and sharing. This adds significant value.

title: Accessibility improvements
description: Conduct an accessibility audit and implement necessary improvements to comply with WCAG standards. This is crucial for inclusivity.

title: Mobile layout issues
description: The application's layout is broken on various mobile devices, leading to a poor user experience. Responsive design needs fixing.

title: Two-factor authentication
description: Implement two-factor authentication (2FA) for enhanced security of user accounts. This is a critical security feature.

title: API endpoint examples
description: Add more detailed examples for each API endpoint in the documentation to make it easier for developers to integrate. Current examples are too basic.

title: Incorrect date formatting
description: Dates are displayed in an inconsistent and sometimes incorrect format across the application. This needs standardization.

title: User feedback form
description: Integrate a user feedback form within the application to collect suggestions and bug reports directly from users. This will improve product development.

title: Database migration
description: Plan and execute a migration of the current database to a more scalable and performant solution. This is a backend infrastructure task.

title: Email verification not sending
description: Email verification links are not being sent to new users, preventing them from activating their accounts. This is a critical onboarding issue.

title: Customizable Dashboard
description: Allow users to customize the widgets and layout of their dashboard to prioritize information relevant to them. This enhances user control.

title: Tutorial videos
description: Create a series of short tutorial videos to guide users through key features of the application. Visual guides are often more effective.
